title: Can this run be turned around?
hook: Tagged equal keys make a tempting shortcut dangerous.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Reverse a strictly descending run while refusing to reverse tied keys that would lose stability.

misconception: Any nonincreasing run may be reversed without changing equal-key order.
objective: Reverse a strictly descending run while refusing to reverse tied keys that would lose stability.

claims.text: Reversal is safe for a strictly descending run because it contains no equal keys. Extending through equality would reverse the tagged equals and break their original order.
